driver.text: Per Reuters, the Nasdaq hit a near three-month low on Friday as results from Amazon and Intel rattled the AI trade: Amazon reported a sharp third-quarter cash outflow and signaled higher capex next year (shares -2% at midday after paring larger premarket losses), and Intel warned it would burn cash this year, falling nearly 29%, its steepest one-day drop on record. Coinbase fell 13% as the $6.3 billion Binance heist weighed on crypto-linked stocks. Index levels are as of 11:52 AM ET, not closing figures.

cryptoDriver.text: Hackers stole $6.3 billion from Binance in the largest crypto theft on record. Prices are lows as of the 5:15 AM ET update, not 4:00 PM ET quotes.

items.headline: Circle froze more than $800 million of assets tied to the $6.3B Binance hack
items.summary: Per Bloomberg, about half of the stolen assets were frozen by stablecoin issuers; Circle froze more than $800 million and Tether nearly $1.57 billion. Binance halted withdrawals and said it expects to resume within 48 hours. Relevant to USDC issuer actions and crypto-market sentiment; Circle's share move is not stated in the source.
